Overview

Tarija is a city in TJ with a population of 268,000. The wine capital of Bolivia, set in a scenic valley with a mild climate and growing wine tourism industry. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
